verdict.rationale: Capacities offers a REST API with Bearer-token auth and an MCP client integration path, but there is no evidence of a CLI, headless mode, or CI/automation-oriented documentation or examples; the product is presented as a desktop/mobile knowledge app, not a headless-runnable tool. missing for 10: CLI or headless execution mode, CI pipeline examples/docs, evidence of automated/unattended API usage in production.
